entries.title: Move tasks from the Tasks list on iPhone and iPad
entries.body: On iPhone and iPad, a long press on a task in Tasks shows its crew summary with the moves your Mac's task board offers for it: Open record, Show the card, Continue, Queue it, Back to backlog, Start now and Drop task. A move that cannot run stays dim and says why, and Start now and Drop task ask once first. Swipe a Backlog task to the left for the Start your Mac shows on that row, which starts it in one press or says why it cannot.
entries.noPicture: The phone check pictures the Tasks list on iPhone and iPad upright, while a hero picture is a landscape pair cropped from the desktop app's window.
